why: Praise and thanks to the Lord of all the worlds.
We have no knowledge except what God has taught us; only He is the Knower, the Wise.
Do not mix truth with falsehood or hide what is true.
Seek help in patience and prayer; it is hard, except for the humble.
Wherever you turn, God is there; you are never out of reach.
Remember God and He remembers you; give thanks.
The order of nature, night and day, sea and rain, holds signs for those who think.
Enjoy the good things you are given and be thankful.
Do not take others' property wrongfully or bribe your way to it.
Spend for good on parents, kin, orphans, the needy and travellers; God knows every good deed.
trim: They ask thee, (O Muhammad), what they shall spend. Say:

why: God never sleeps and never tires of preserving the heavens and the earth; all of it belongs to Him.
Giving is like a grain that grows seven ears, each with a hundred grains.
A kind word and forgiveness are better than charity followed by hurt.
Whoever is given wisdom has been given abundant good.
Giving openly is good, but giving quietly to the poor is better.
Look out for the poor who are in need but too dignified to beg, and help them.
Give a struggling debtor time, and forgiving the debt is better still.
A prayer that the heart not stray once it has found its way.
You do not reach true goodness until you give from what you love.
Be people who invite others to goodness; that is true success.
When people do wrong, they remember God, ask forgiveness and do not knowingly repeat it; only God forgives sins.
God is your protector, the best of helpers.
Creation and the change of night and day are signs for thoughtful people.
All people come from one soul; honour the ties of kinship.
God wants to lighten your burden, for people were created weak.
Do not covet what others have; ask God of His bounty instead.
Not even an ant's weight of good is lost; good deeds are multiplied.
Return what is entrusted to you and judge between people fairly.
Whoever stands up for a good cause shares in its reward.
When greeted, return the greeting with one better or equal.
There is no good in much secret talk, except in urging charity, kindness and making peace between people.
Stand firm for justice even against yourself or your family.
Do not let hatred of anyone push you into being unjust.
Whoever repents after doing wrong and makes amends is forgiven.
Peace be on you: whoever does wrong in ignorance, repents and mends finds mercy.
Not a leaf falls without God knowing; nothing is unseen.
God made the night for stillness and rest.
The stars are given to guide your way through darkness.
Deal fairly, keep your word even against kin; no soul is tasked beyond its strength.
A good deed is rewarded ten times over.
Call on God in fear and hope; His mercy is near to those who do good.
A prayer for mercy on oneself and one's brother.
Those who did wrong and then repented find God forgiving and merciful.
Remember your Lord within yourself, humbly and quietly, morning and evening.
Do not betray the trusts placed in you.
Those who admit their faults, having mixed good with bad, may hope for mercy.
Keep company with the truthful.
Guidance comes as a balm for what is in the heart.
Rejoice in God's bounty and mercy; it is better than anything hoarded.
The night was given you to rest in, and the day to see by.
Every creature's sustenance rests with God, who knows where each one dwells.
Abraham greets strangers with peace and hurries to feed them.
Give full measure and weight, and do not cheat people of their goods.
Shu'aib says he wants only to set things right as far as he can, and that his welfare rests in God.
Good deeds wipe away bad ones.
Be patient; God does not let the reward of the good be lost.
I do not claim to be blameless; the self pulls toward wrong, but God is merciful.
A father takes sensible precautions for his sons, then puts his trust in God.
Jacob turned away and grieved for Joseph, his eyes whitened by the sorrow he held in.
I pour out my distress and sorrow only to God.
Joseph, reunited with his parents, says God was kind to him in freeing him from prison and bringing them out of the desert after Satan caused strife with his brothers.
In the remembrance of God hearts find rest.
trim: Who have believed and whose hearts have rest in the remembrance of Allah.

why: A good word is like a good tree, rooted firm with branches in the sky.
A parent's prayer for themselves and their children to be steady in prayer.
If you tried to count God's blessings, you could not number them.
Every comfort you enjoy is from God.
You were born knowing nothing and given hearing, sight and hearts, so be grateful.
Keep your promises and do not break your oaths.
Whoever does right, man or woman, will be given a good life.
Eat of the good things provided and be thankful.
For those who did wrong in ignorance and then repented and mended, God forgives.
Invite with wisdom and kind advice; reason with people in the best way.
God is with those who do good.
God knows what is in your heart and forgives those who turn back.
Give relatives, the needy and travellers their due, and do not waste.
Be neither tight-fisted nor so lavish that you are left with nothing.
Protect what belongs to the vulnerable and keep your commitments.
Measure fully and weigh fairly; it is better in the end.
Do not follow what you have no knowledge of.
Do not walk the earth with arrogance; you cannot split the earth or match the mountains.
Tell people to say what is kindest, for the devil sows discord among them.
Every child of Adam has been honoured.
Truth has come and falsehood has vanished; falsehood is bound to fade.
A prayer for mercy and for right direction in a hard situation.
The reward of good work is never lost.
Wealth and children adorn this life, but lasting good deeds are better hope.
If the sea were ink for the words of my Lord, the sea would run dry first.
For those who believe and do good, the Merciful will create love.
My Lord, relieve my mind.
And make my task easy for me.
A prayer to be freed from the knot in one's tongue.
Do not fear; I am with you, hearing and seeing.
Our Lord gave everything its nature, then guided it.
Fear not; you are the one who is uppermost.
God forgives whoever repents, believes, does good and keeps to the right way.
Whoever does good need not fear injustice or being cheated of their due.
Pray: my Lord, increase me in knowledge.
trim: Then exalted be Allah, the True King! And hasten not (O Muhammad) with the Qur'an ere its revelation hath been perfected unto thee, and say:

why: No soul will be wronged at all; even a mustard seed's weight is counted.
Job cried out: hardship has touched me, and You are the most merciful.
No good effort is rejected; it is recorded.
Pray: my Lord, forgive and have mercy; You are the best of the merciful.
God is the light of the heavens and earth: light upon light.
Night and day follow each other for whoever wants to remember or give thanks.
When spending, be neither wasteful nor stingy, but in between.
Whoever repents and does good truly turns back to God.
Do not take part in falsehood, and pass by idle mockery with dignity.
Moses says: my Lord is with me; He will guide me.
trim: He said: Nay, verily! for lo!

why: Do not cheat people of what is theirs or spread corruption.
Put your trust in the Mighty, the Merciful.
God wills to show favour to those who were oppressed.
Moses fled danger, watchful and afraid, praying to be kept safe from those who would harm him.
Setting out for an unknown place: perhaps my Lord will guide me the right way.
After helping strangers, Moses prayed: I am in need of whatever good You send me.
The best one to hire is the strong and trustworthy.
trim: One of the two women said:

why: When they hear idle talk they turn away and say: peace be with you.
Night and day are a mercy: one for rest, one for seeking your living.
Whoever strives, strives for their own good.
Discuss differences of faith only in the best way: our God and your God is One.
Many creatures carry no provision, yet God provides for them and for you.
Those who strive for God are guided to His paths.
God made partners for you to find rest in and placed love and mercy between you.
The variety of your languages and colours is a sign for those who know.
Your sleep by night and day and your seeking of His bounty are signs for those who listen.
Give relatives, the needy and travellers their due.
Life moves from weakness to strength and back to weakness; all is in God's hands.
God gave Luqman wisdom and told him to give thanks; whoever gives thanks does so for their own good.
A father teaches: even a mustard seed's weight, hidden in a rock, God brings to light.
Do not turn your face from people in scorn or walk proudly.
If every tree were a pen and the sea ink, God's words would not run out.
Put your trust in God; He is enough to rely on.
Those who malign the innocent carry the guilt of slander.
Moses was slandered, but God cleared his name.
Speak words that are straight and true.
Whatever you spend for good, God replaces it.
God accepts repentance and pardons wrongs.
God sends saving rain after people have despaired.
All that is in the heavens and earth has been made of service to you.
Help God's cause and He will help you and steady your feet.
Believers are siblings, so make peace between them.
Peoples were made different so they might know one another; the noblest is the best in conduct.
God knows what your soul whispers and is nearer than your own jugular vein.
In their wealth was a rightful share for the one who asks and the one who goes without.
It is God who gives livelihood.
And their effort will be seen.
Every day God is at work.
Is the reward of goodness anything but goodness?
God is with you wherever you are.
God heard the woman who brought her complaint about her husband.
Those who welcomed refugees put them first even in poverty; freedom from greed is success.
Pray: forgive us and those before us, and leave no bitterness in our hearts.
God may yet put love between you and those you are at odds with.
Why say what you do not do?
After prayer, go out and seek your living, remembering God often.
Whoever puts their trust in God, He is enough for them; God has set a measure for all things.
trim: And will provide for him from (a quarter) whence he hath no expectation. And

why: Give according to your means; after hardship, God brings ease.
We feed you for God's sake alone, wanting no reward or thanks.
Your sleep is made for rest.
Whoever grows in goodness has succeeded.
Be among those who encourage one another to persevere and to be compassionate.
Your Lord has not forsaken you, nor does He hate you.
Your Lord will give you, and you will be content.
Were you not an orphan, and He sheltered you?
Did He not find you wandering and guide you?
Were you not in need, and He provided for you?
So do not oppress the orphan.
And do not turn away the one who asks.
And speak of your Lord's blessings.
With hardship comes ease.
Truly, with hardship comes ease.
Strive to please your Lord.
People were created in the finest form.
Whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it.
